name: Narq
tagline: Compliance that narcs on your operation before the regulators can.
positioning: Narq is the seed-to-sale compliance layer for multistate cannabis operators who'd rather catch their own violations than let an inspector do it for them.

hero.h1: Stay legal in 24 states without a spreadsheet named FINAL_v7.
hero.sub: Narq syncs every package, transfer, and license to METRC and BioTrack in real time, then flags the violation before an inspector ever puts on gloves.

features.title: METRC sync that actually holds
features.description: Two-way sync with METRC and BioTrack across every state you operate in. When a tag mismatches, Narq fixes it or tells you exactly which human to yell at.

features.title: License babysitter
features.description: Every state, local, and facility license tracked with renewal deadlines, so nobody discovers an expired permit during a surprise Tuesday audit.

features.title: Audit trail nobody can gaslight
features.description: Immutable chain-of-custody logs for every gram, edible, and pre-roll. Export a defensible packet for inspectors in one click, not one weekend.

features.title: Violation radar
features.description: Rules engine watches limits, transfer manifests, and testing gaps in real time and pings the person who can fix it before it becomes a fine.

features.title: Excise tax without tears
features.description: Reconciles sales, waste, and tax obligations per jurisdiction so your CFO stops treating quarter-close like a hostage negotiation.

features.title: Multistate command deck
features.description: One dashboard for compliance officers running 40 facilities across a dozen wildly inconsistent regulatory regimes.

testimonials.quote: We used to reconcile METRC by hand across nine states. Narq caught a manifest error that would've cost us a suspension. It paid for itself in the first month, which is annoying because I liked complaining.
testimonials.name: Danielle Ferraro

testimonials.quote: Our last audit took eleven days to prep. With Narq I pulled the packet in an afternoon and spent the rest of the week doing literally anything else.
testimonials.name: Marcus Ojeda

testimonials.quote: The violation alerts are almost rude about how fast they are. I'd rather be embarrassed by software than fined by a regulator, so we're keeping it.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman
